setup: Set the initial administrator email and password before first start, or create the first account in Beszel.
Add agents using keys from the hub; do not expose agent listeners to arbitrary networks.
integration_notes: Native settings include heartbeat receivers, MFA policy and container-detail access.
Configure OAuth providers in PocketBase administration before disabling password login.
limitations: Email OTP requires working SMTP. Selfhost does not yet register a PocketBase provider automatically.
